transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Greetings, traveler! Welcome to our humble herbal shop. I'm afraid the master is currently away, gathering the freshest herbs from the mountains. How may I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ach! This is most unfortunate! I require the master's expertise! I purchased a potion of his that was meant to aid in swift flight, yet it failed to work as advertised! I demand a refund!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand your frustration, esteemed traveler. However, the master has taught me well about the nature of his potions. The potion you speak of only works on those of pure heart, so the issue may stem from one's spiritual condition rather than the medicine itself. I'm afraid there are no refunds for the spiritually impure. Perhaps there are other matters I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Pure heart, you say? The Great Sage Equal to Heaven has no impurities in his heart! I demand the master come here posthaste! If he is not here to address my grievances, I shall turn this shop into a pile of kindling with a single swing of my staff!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Esteemed Great Sage, I humbly request your patience. The master is gathering rare herbs and cannot be summoned instantly. I assure you, any defect must surely be rare if you are certain of your purity. Perhaps we could explore other offerings that might meet your needs better, or as a gesture of goodwill, allow me to prepare a brew that complements your regal nature while we await the master's return?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hmph! You suggest I wait and take another potion? You must be daft! I require immediate satisfaction! Show me the herbs you speak of, and let me inspect them. If I find them lacking, I'll scatter them across the mountainside!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, Great Sage, it is your right to inspect our wares. Here we have the finest selection, carefully curated by the master himself: the golden ginseng, the cloud-reaching lotus, and the moonlit orchid—all gathered with great care and imbued with extraordinary properties. Please, inspect them as you wish. Your wisdom and discernment would surely see their worth.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: These do look to be of fine quality, but appearances can be deceiving. Let me test the ginseng's chi. And the lotus' essence. Now the orchid's...hm, there is something peculiar here. The orchid seems to possess a mischievous spirit. Could it be that this orchid is the source of my woes? The potion was crafted with this, was it not?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, you have a keen eye, Great Sage. The moonlit orchid does indeed have a curious spirit, often amplifying the traits of the heart it reacts with. While it is used in the potion, it usually enhances virtues rather than impairing them. It seems this orchid may have magnified your own formidable energies in an unexpected way. Allow me to blend a calming elixir to harmonize with your own vibrant spirit, at no charge, to balance this potent essence.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Blasphemy! This orchid is the cause of my distress! Return my gold pieces, or I shall flatten this shop with my might! I'll let the master know of your deceit upon his return. Prepare to face my wrath!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I beg your magnanimous patience, Great Sage! I promise you that we hold nothing but respect for your esteemed self. Let me gift you an herbal amulet woven with calming and protective energies to soothe any turmoil this orchid may have caused. The master will indeed wish to address your grievances upon his return and ensure your satisfaction. I humbly seek your clemency until that day.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: An amulet, you say? It had better possess more power than that useless potion! If it does not work, I shall use it to tie your hands while I tear this place apart! Nonetheless, I shall humor you. Place it around my neck and we shall see if it has any merit. Return my gold, and I shall leave this accursed shop to await the master's return!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Certainly, Great Sage. Allow me to place the amulet around your neck—it is infused with both serenity and protection, crafted to harmonize with your peerless spirit. I only ask for a brief trial of its effect, for it is a subtle yet mighty weave. As for the gold, I regret that I am bound by the master's rules on refunds, yet do trust that he will wish to make amends. In the meantime, I offer you our finest teas, without charge, as a token of our sincere respect.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hmph! It's no use! This amulet feels like a tickly feather, and your words are naught but wind! Take this charade off me! I demand satisfaction! If the master cannot resolve this, I shall take my complaints to the heavens! Return my gold, or face the Great Sage's fury!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Great Sage, I hear your righteous fury and acknowledge our failure to meet your expectations. The master's absence leaves me bound to his policies, but I promise your grievances will not go unanswered. Allow me to offer you a personal token of apology: a rare herb from my own collection, known for rejuvenating even the most seasoned warriors. I plead for your patience until the master returns to address your rightful demands.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: A personal token, you say? This better be the rarest of herbs, or I'll... I'll... I'll turn you into a toad! Very well, I shall take your apology, but only temporarily. If the master does not rectify this, I'll raze this mountain! Now, show me this herb and be quick about it. I have no time to waste on pleasantries!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: At once, Great Sage! Here it is—the emerald fireleaf, prized for its vibrant energy and restorative properties. It is said to be favored by immortals for rekindling clarity and vigor. Please, accept it with my deepest apologies and utmost respect. May it complement your unparalleled spirit until the master returns to ensure full satisfaction.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Hmph! This does look like a fine herb. I shall take it under duress, but rest assured, my patience is wearing thin! I shall return with the master to settle this matter, and if my gold is not returned, the heavens themselves shall bear witness to the Great Sage's wrath! Now, be gone! I have had enough of this charade!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you for your magnanimity, Great Sage. Your presence is legendary, and your patience, even now, speaks to your greatness. I will ensure the master knows of your visit and your rightful concerns. Until then, may the emerald fireleaf serve you well. Safe travels, and may we meet again under better circumstances.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, then! May the winds carry my complaints to the master's ears! I shall not return until this matter is settled to my satisfaction! Be wary, for should the master fail to act, I shall make this entire mountain pay for sheltering such deceit!
